briefdescription.para: DeviceMergeSort provides device-wide, parallel operations for computing a merge sort across a sequence of data items residing within device-accessible memory.

listitem.para: DeviceMergeSort arranges items into ascending order using a comparison functor with less-than semantics. Merge sort can handle arbitrary types (as long as a value of these types is a model of LessThan Comparable) and comparison functors, but is slower than DeviceRadixSort when sorting arithmetic types into ascending/descending order.
Another difference from RadixSort is the fact that DeviceMergeSort can handle arbitrary random-access iterators, as shown below.
